iterations.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="https://example.com/bpmn/find-a-job"
                  id="Definitions_FindAJob">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Application" name="Job application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationConfirmation" name="Application confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicationRating" name="Application rating"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_WorkInvitation" name="Invitation to work"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProbationComplete" name="Probation completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CompanyReview" name="Review of the company"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ApplicantRating" name="Rating of the applicant"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PermanentStatus" name="Probation outcome"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FindAJob" name="Find a Job">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Job applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company" processRef="Process_Company"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Job application" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplication" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Application confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicationRating" name="Application rating" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicationRating" targetRef="Event_ReceiveApplicationRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PotentialOffer" name="Potential job offer" sourceRef="Task_SendPotentialOffer" targetRef="Event_ReceivePotentialOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_WorkInvitation" name="Invitation to work" sourceRef="Task_SendWorkInvitation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveWorkInvitation" messageRef="Message_WorkInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProbationComplete" name="Probation completed" sourceRef="Task_SendProbationComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyReview" name="Review of the company" sourceRef="Task_SendCompanyReview" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ApplicantRating" name="Rating of the applicant" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Event_ReceiveApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PermanentStatus" name="Probation outcome" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Event_ReceivePermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Find a Job — Applicant" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ApplicantStart" name="Job search begins"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplication" name="Apply to a company" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicantSplit" name="Continue application and reporting"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportApplications" name="Regularly report companies applied to"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ReportComplete" name="Applications reported"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive application confirmation">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Confirmation" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveApplicationRating" name="Receive application rating">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicationRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicationRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceivePotentialOffer" name="Receive potential job offer">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PotentialOffer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewSplit" name="Negotiate an interview?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateInterview" name="Negotiate a job interview"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InterviewMerge" name="Continue after interview decision"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveWorkInvitation" name="Receive invitation to work">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_WorkInvitation" messageRef="Message_WorkInvitation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Probation" name="Complete probation phase"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" name="Complete post-probation actions"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendCompanyReview" name="Rate the company" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProbationComplete" name="Report probation completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveApplicantRating" name="Receive company rating of applicant">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ApplicantRating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceivePermanentStatus" name="Receive probation outcome">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PermanentStatus" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostProbationJoin" name="Post-probation actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Permanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RatingThreshold" name="Was the company rated C or less?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PermanentEnd" name="Job is permanent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_NotPermanentEnd" name="Job did not become permanent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Event_ApplicantStart" targetRef="Task_SendApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_SendApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicantSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantSplit" targetRef="Task_ReportApplications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" sourceRef="Task_ReportApplications" targetRef="Event_ReportComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicantSplit" targetRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Event_ReceiveApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveApplicationRating" targetRef="Event_ReceivePotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" sourceRef="Event_ReceivePotentialOffer" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" name="Interview negotiated" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Task_NegotiateInterview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" name="No interview negotiation" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewSplit" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">interviewNegotiated = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateInterview" targetRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Gateway_InterviewMerge" targetRef="Event_ReceiveWorkInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveWorkInvitation" targetRef="Task_Probation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Task_Probation" targetRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Task_SendCompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Task_SendCompanyReview" targetRef="Gateway_PostProbationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationSplit" targetRef="Task_SendProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" sourceRef="Task_SendProbationComplete" targetRef="Event_ReceiveApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A19" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveApplicantRating" targetRef="Event_ReceivePermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A20" sourceRef="Event_ReceivePermanentStatus" targetRef="Gateway_PostProbationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A21" sourceRef="Gateway_PostProbationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_Permanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A22" name="Permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobBecamePermanent = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A23" name="Not permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_Permanent" targetRef="Event_NotPermanentEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobBecamePermanent = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A24" name="C or less" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Event_ReceivePotentialOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRating <= C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A25" name="Above C" sourceRef="Gateway_RatingThreshold" targetRef="Event_PermanentEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">companyRating > C</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company application and probation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_CompanyStart" name="Application handling begins"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApplication" name="Receive job application" messageRef="Message_Application"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyResponseSplit" name="Confirm and rate application"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm receipt of application" messageRef="Message_ApplicationConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicationRating" name="Rate application" messageRef="Message_ApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyResponseJoin" name="Confirmation and rating complete"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPotentialOffer" name="Send potential job offer" messageRef="Message_PotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WantsApplicant" name="Does the company want the applicant to work for it?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_NoHireEnd" name="No invitation to work"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendWorkInvitation" name="Invite applicant to work" messageRef="Message_WorkInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" name="Receive probation completion" messageRef="Message_ProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" name="Complete post-probation actions"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RateApplicant" name="Rate the applicant"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendApplicantRating" name="Send applicant rating" messageRef="Message_ApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JobPermanent" name="Did the job become permanent?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPermanentStatus" name="Report permanent outcome" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNonPermanentStatus" name="Report non-permanent outcome" messageRef="Message_PermanentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_StatusSentEnd" name="Probation outcome reported"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview" name="Receive company review" messageRef="Message_CompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitOneYear" name="Wait one year">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_OneYear">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1Y</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReviewVisible" name="Make company review visible to job applicants"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ReviewVisibleEnd" name="Company review visible"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C1" sourceRef="Event_CompanyStart" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C2" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApplication" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyResponseSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyResponseSplit" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyResponseSplit" targetRef="Task_SendApplicationRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C5" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyResponseJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C6" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicationRating" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyResponseJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C7" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyResponseJoin" targetRef="Task_SendPotentialOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C8" sourceRef="Task_SendPotentialOffer" targetRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C9" name="Does not want applicant" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Event_NoHireEnd">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wantsApplicant = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" name="Wants applicant" sourceRef="Gateway_WantsApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendWorkInvitation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wantsApplicant = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="Task_SendWorkInvitation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProbationComplete" targetRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" targetRef="Task_RateApplicant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="Task_RateApplicant" targetRef="Task_SendApplicantRating"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Task_SendApplicantRating" targetRef="Gateway_JobPermanent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" name="Permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendPermanentStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobBecamePermanent = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" name="Not permanent" sourceRef="Gateway_JobPermanent" targetRef="Task_SendNonPermanentStatus">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">jobBecamePermanent = false</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="Task_SendPermanentStatus" targetRef="Event_StatusSentEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="Task_SendNonPermanentStatus" targetRef="Event_StatusSentEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="Gateway_CompanyPostProbationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCompanyReview" targetRef="Event_WaitOneYear"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C22" sourceRef="Event_WaitOneYear" targetRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C23" sourceRef="Task_MakeReviewVisible" targetRef="Event_ReviewVisibleEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
